economia|asia.title: South Korea’s Lee Proposes Talks With North in Pursuit of Peace
economia|asia.summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung called for dialogue with North Korea to reduce military tensions and achieve peaceful coexistence. The proposal aims to ease peninsula hostilities.

economia|asia.title: China Protests Japan PM, Defense Minister’s Yasukuni Actions
economia|asia.summary: China lodged a formal protest after Japan's Prime Minister Takaichi sent an offering to Yasukuni shrine and Defense Minister Koizumi visited it. China objects to the shrine visits as historically insensitive.

economia|asia.title: India Raises $50 Billion From Diaspora, Ends Swap Facility Early
economia|asia.summary: India mobilized over $50 billion from overseas citizens since June, prompting the central bank to close its special foreign-currency window early. The fundraising exceeded expectations.

economia|asia.title: China's Z.ai launches model it says rivals Anthropic's Mythos
economia|asia.summary: China's Z.ai launched an AI model claiming to rival Anthropic's offerings. The release intensifies competition in advanced large language model development.

economia|asia.title: Vietnam public spending boom boosts infrastructure earnings
economia|asia.summary: Vietnam's public spending boom is boosting infrastructure earnings across the sector. Increased investment is driving economic activity in transportation and construction.

economia|europa.title: El Gobierno amplía la vida de la central nuclear de Almaraz hasta 2030 por la “volatilidad de precios” originada en Oriente Próximo
economia|europa.summary: El Gobierno amplía la vida de la central nuclear de Almaraz hasta 2030 debido a la volatilidad de precios en Oriente Próximo. Mantiene el calendario de cierres de otras centrales hasta 2035.

economia|europa.title: US, Canada Still See Sticking Points Before Deadline for 50% Tariffs
economia|europa.summary: US and Canada still face significant obstacles before the tariff deadline next week. Trade negotiators must resolve remaining issues to prevent new 50% tariffs.

economia|europa.title: Francia encara en año electoral su ajuste de cuentas con la deuda
economia|europa.summary: Francia afronta en año electoral un ajuste de cuentas con su deuda. La economía gala se financia más cara que otras grandes economías del euro y su déficit se dispara.

economia|europa.title: Las alianzas universitarias, el nuevo activo estratégico de Europa
economia|europa.summary: Las universidades europeas integradas en alianzas estratégicas cofinancian sus déficits con presupuestos propios como inversión estratégica. Estas redes universitarias se consolidan como activo clave para Europa.

economia|america.title: US accuses more than 40 countries of helping China avoid Trump’s tariffs
economia|america.summary: The White House accused over 40 countries including Canada, Japan, and EU members of enabling Chinese tariff evasion worth $60 billion via transshipment schemes. US officials claim systematic circumvention.

economia|america.title: Canada Must End Retaliation to Avoid New Tariffs, Greer Says
economia|america.summary: US Trade Representative Greer says Canada must end retaliatory trade measures against US products to avoid new tariffs taking effect next week. The White House demands policy reversal.

economia|america.title: Americans sour on Trump’s economy as affordability strains intensify
economia|america.summary: Consumer sentiment and retail sales fell as affordability strains intensify and Middle East tensions worsen cost of living pressures. Americans increasingly disapprove of Trump's economic record.

economia|america.title: Fed’s Goolsbee Wants to See More Evidence of Cooling Inflation
economia|america.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago President Austan Goolsbee expressed encouragement over recent inflation cooling but wants more evidence in coming months. Further confirmation is needed for confidence.

politica|asia.title: 普京首次访问日俄争议岛屿，激怒东京
politica|asia.summary: 普京首次访问俄日争议岛屿重申领土主张，抗议日本对俄制裁。此举引发东京强烈谴责和外交纠纷。

politica|asia.title: US team sent to Taiwan to train coastguards amid surge in mainland Chinese activity
politica|asia.summary: The United States sent a coastguard training team to Taiwan as Beijing increases military presence near the island. The deployment supports Taiwan's capacity-building amid regional tensions.

politica|asia.title: Miles ahead: China team boosts atom entanglement distance record fourfold
politica|asia.summary: Chinese scientists achieved quantum entanglement of cold atoms across 420 kilometers, quadrupling the previous record distance. The breakthrough advances intercity quantum network development.

politica|asia.title: 伊朗嗆美「接受戰敗現實」 川普籲民眾接受油價漲
politica|asia.summary: 伊朗要求美国接受战败现实，川普斥伊朗为邪恶国家并警告油价上涨。两国对峙加剧中东地区紧张局势。

politica|europa.title: Afghanistan's Taliban break out of international isolation five years after returning to power
politica|europa.summary: Afghanistan's Taliban broke out of international isolation five years after returning to power through regional trade discussions and counterterrorism negotiations with American and European officials. Diplomatic engagement is expanding.

politica|europa.title: Venezuela frees over 130 political prisoners amid post-Maduro talks
politica|europa.summary: Venezuela freed over 130 political prisoners amid post-election talks with the interim government. The releases follow opposition figure Dinorah Figuera's commitment to fight for prisoner freedom.

politica|europa.title: Jason Arday: Ex-Cambridge professor at centre of plagiarism scandal found dead
politica|europa.summary: Jason Arday, Cambridge's youngest Black professor, was found dead in London while facing a plagiarism scandal. He had recently resigned amid the controversy.

politica|europa.title: Probe into €5.8 million gift to Nigel Farage reopens as he wins by-election
politica|europa.summary: Nigel Farage of far-right Reform UK reclaimed his Clacton seat, triggering reopening of a parliamentary standards probe into a £5 million cryptocurrency donation. The investigation resumes with his by-election victory.

politica|europa.title: Congo: Ebola cases are rising at record pace
politica|europa.summary: Ebola cases are rising at record pace in the Democratic Republic of Congo with significant spread in Kinshasa. Hospitals are preparing for a potential major health crisis.

politica|america.title: Mangione admits killing healthcare CEO and pleads guilty to federal charges
politica|america.summary: Luigi Mangione, 28, admitted to killing healthcare CEO Brian Thompson in Manhattan and pleaded guilty to federal charges including stalking resulting in death. The confession concluded a high-profile case.

politica|america.title: U.S. missionary who was kidnapped in Niger is released
politica|america.summary: US missionary Kevin Rideout, kidnapped in Niger, was released and is in good health under US care. He will soon be reunited with his family.

politica|america.title: New aircraft carrier heads toward Mideast after reports of issues on long-deployed USS Lincoln
politica|america.summary: The USS George Washington aircraft carrier began heading toward the Middle East as the long-deployed USS Lincoln faces mental health and supply issues. Fresh carrier deployment provides replacement capability.

politica|america.title: Sen. Ruben Gallego on handling of USS Lincoln conditions: 'That's not proper leadership'
politica|america.summary: Democratic Senator Ruben Gallego criticized Pentagon leadership for failing to properly address living conditions aboard the USS Lincoln. Lawmakers demand answers about sailor welfare.

politica|america.title: Trump extiende sus tentáculos militares en Latinoamérica
politica|america.summary: Trump extiende su presencia militar en Latinoamérica planteando operaciones en Colombia y no descartando opciones militares en Cuba. La estrategia choca con la resistencia regional.

tecnologia|america.title: Vulnerability giving attackers full control of Macs is under active exploitation
tecnologia|america.summary: A critical macOS screen-sharing vulnerability allowing remote password-free login is under active exploitation. The bug represents a severe security threat to affected systems.

tecnologia|america.title: Self-driving trucks are officially testing on California highways
tecnologia|america.summary: Aurora Innovation and Kodiak AI received California Department of Motor Vehicles permits for official self-driving truck testing on highways. Commercial autonomous trucking testing is now authorized.

tecnologia|america.title: Suspecting court of using AI, man injected prompts in filings to try to win case
tecnologia|america.summary: A pro se litigant attempted to inject AI prompts in court filings suspecting the court used AI, but the judge warned litigants are using chatbots incorrectly. The tactic proved ineffective.

tecnologia|america.title: What we know about the alleged Iranian hacks on US water utilities
tecnologia|america.summary: Iranian hackers targeted and breached systems at multiple US water utility plants in recent weeks. The campaign highlights vulnerability of critical infrastructure to state-sponsored attack.

tecnologia|america.title: Judge gives Google one week to fix "anticompetitive" app store download in Google Play
tecnologia|america.summary: A judge ordered Google to fix 'anticompetitive' Google Play app store download practices within one week. Third-party app stores will become more visible to users.

tecnologia|europa.title: Z.ai entrenó GLM-5.3 para programar mejor. El modelo aprendió de paso a ser mucho mejor en ciberseguridad
tecnologia|europa.summary: El modelo GLM-5.3 de Z.ai, entrenado para mejorar programación, mejoró simultáneamente en ciberseguridad. El entrenamiento para una tarea benefició inesperadamente otras capacidades.

tecnologia|europa.title: Esther Bastida, la científica de la misión de la ESA que 'crea' 4.000 eclipses al año: "Muchos son inaccesibles a los telescopios, por eso es tan útil generarlos artificialmente"
tecnologia|europa.summary: Esther Bastida, científica de la ESA, crea 4.000 eclipses anuales artificialmente para investigación. Muchos eclipses naturales son inaccesibles a telescopios, por eso la generación artificial resulta útil.

tecnologia|europa.title: Australia protegió sus cables submarinos. Dos han fallado casi a la vez justo cuando un barco rondaba por la zona
tecnologia|europa.summary: Australia protegió sus cables submarinos tras fallos simultáneos de dos cuando un barco rondaba la zona. La infraestructura submarina es crítica para comunicaciones e internet.

tecnologia|asia.title: 【資安週報】0810~0814，疑中國駭客打造AI自主攻擊框架對臺發動攻擊，資安署表示已對此人機結合境外攻擊展開應變
tecnologia|asia.summary: 中国驭客使用AI自主攻击框架对台湾政府机关和能源公司发动攻击。台湾资安署已启动应变措施应对这一新型混合攻击威胁。

tecnologia|asia.title: xAI 前共同創辦人新創 River AI 獲 11 億美元融資，主打低成本企業客製化 AI 模型
tecnologia|asia.summary: xAI前共同创办人创办的River AI获得11亿美元融资。资金用于扩大企业级AI工具组助客户开发定制化AI模型。

tecnologia|asia.title: 雲端安全聯盟揭2026年11大雲端威脅，AI強化攻擊與AI系統遭入侵首度進榜
tecnologia|asia.summary: 云端安全联盟公布2026年云端威胁报告，AI强化攻击和AI系统遭入侵首次进入前11名。企业采用AI和云服务面临新型安全风险。

tecnologia|asia.title: 中國駭客Jewelbug間諜與加密貨幣詐騙並行，共用控制平臺與伺服器
tecnologia|asia.summary: 中国驭客组织Jewelbug同时进行政府间谍活动和针对华语使用者的加密货币诈骗。两项行动共用控制平台、伺服器和受害者数据库。
